description:
Read any web page in a real browser and get a summary of it in one call, with its title and final URL. Says when the page was longer than the part summarized.

$0.007 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

url.description: Absolute https URL of the page.

name: page_brief
title: Page brief
